verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list continuous batching and chunked prefill as core features and tie its scheduling and continuous batching to peak GPU utilization. Community users confirm continuous batching underpins production throughput, and the CLI ships throughput benchmarking. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of chunked prefill configuration and tuning, independent quantified throughput results attributable to these features.
